entries.title: Job 35:2
segments: Thinkest thou this to be right, that thou saidst, My righteousness is more than *God's?

entries.title: Job 35:3
segments: For thou hast asked of what profit it is unto thee: what do I gain more than if I had sinned?

entries.title: Job 35:4
segments: I will reply to thee in words, and to thy companions with thee.

entries.title: Job 35:5
segments: Look unto the heavens and see; and survey the skies: they are higher than thou.

entries.title: Job 35:6
segments: If thou sinnest, what doest thou against him? If thy transgressions be multiplied, what doest thou unto him?

entries.title: Job 35:7
segments: If thou be righteous, what givest thou to him? or what doth he receive of thy hand?

entries.title: Job 35:8
segments: Thy wickedness [may affect] a man as thou [art], and thy righteousness a son of man.

entries.title: Job 35:9
segments: ¶By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry; they cry out by reason of the arm of the mighty:

entries.title: Job 35:10
segments: But none saith, Where is +God my Maker, who giveth songs in the night,

entries.title: Job 35:11
segments: Who teacheth us more than the beasts of the earth, and maketh us wiser than the fowl of the heavens?

entries.title: Job 35:12
segments: There they cry, and he answereth not, because of the pride of evil men.

entries.title: Job 35:13
segments: Surely *God will not hear vanity, neither will the Almighty regard it.

entries.title: Job 35:14
segments: ¶Although thou sayest thou dost not see him, judgment is before him, therefore wait for him.

entries.title: Job 35:15
segments: But now, because he hath not visited in his anger, doth not [Job] know [his] great arrogancy?

entries.title: Job 35:16
segments: For Job hath opened his mouth in vanity, and made words abundant without knowledge.
